option_selection: European, PM settlement flag 0, standard settlement flag 0, contract size 100; valid noncrossed closing bid/ask; DTE 14-180 inclusive; strike/forward 0.8-1.2 inclusive
volatility: sample standard deviation of log SPX close changes ending previous observed session, sqrt(252) annualization; no tuned coefficient
valuation: discounted Black forward price; same-date matched vendor forward and linearly interpolated continuously compounded zero rate; own ACT/365 maturity
vendor_iv: optional consistency diagnostic only; not independent predictive input
slice_family: every year x call/put x DTE [14,30], (30,90], (90,180]; include every predeclared slice and empty ones
public_release: code, numerical grid and synthetic quote fixture; licensed records and detailed/derived real-data outputs private pending applicable publication rights
timing_limit: EOD quotes, underlying close, forward and rate curve may have different observations; calendar-day T is a declared simplification; no intraday/queue/fill claim
